source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 6.3 with Figs. 6.4 and 6.5 (PDF 125).

blocks.text: Heat aur work (kaam) dono energy ko ek jagah se doosri jagah pohanchane ke tareeqe hain. Yeh khayal sab se pehle steam engine par lagaya gaya, jahan heat andar di jati hai aur work bahar liya jata hai. Isi liye andar aane wali heat aur bahar nikalne wale work dono ko positive mana gaya. Yani system apne mahol (environment) par jo work kare woh positive, aur mahol system par jo work kare woh negative. Agar heat Q system mein aaye to woh ya to internal energy barhati hai, ya system mahol par work karta hai, ya dono hote hain.

Work ko aisi cheezon se likh sakte hain jo seedha naapi ja sakti hain. Ek cylinder mein gas band hai jis par cross-sectional area A wala, aasani se hilne wala aur bina friction (ragar) ka piston hai (Fig. 6.4-a). Equilibrium (tawazun, yani thehri hui halat) mein gas ka volume V hai aur woh cylinder ki deewaron aur piston par pressure P dalti hai. Gas piston par jo force F lagati hai woh PA hai.

blocks.alt: (a) Cylinder mein dabao P aur volume V wali gas, raqbe A ke piston se band; piston ki rod par neeche ki taraf force F. (b) Wahi cylinder garam plate par: piston do dashed lakeeron ke darmiyan delta y oopar utha hai aur gas ka volume ab V + delta V hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.4: Gas ek be-wazan, raghrat se paak (frictionless) piston se cylinder mein band hai. Neeche ki taraf mustaqil force F = PA hai (kitab ki Figure 6.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: (b) mein neeche se garmi milne par gas phailti hai aur piston ko force F ke khilaf Δy oopar dhakelti hai, yani gas work karti hai: W = FΔy = PAΔy = PΔV.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Fig. 6.4 ki caption kehti hai ke piston hatne par gas par neeche ki taraf work hota hai (work done on the gas). Magar panel (b) mein gas phail kar piston ko oopar dhakel rahi hai, is liye yahan gas piston par work karti hai, jaisa text bhi kehta hai.
Farz karein gas ΔV jitna bohat aahista phailti hai taake har waqt equilibrium mein rahe (Fig. 6.4-b). Piston chhota sa faasla Δy oopar jata hai, to gas ka kiya hua work W yeh hai:

blocks.text_alt: Kyun ke   AΔy = ΔV   (volume mein tabdeeli)

blocks.text: Work P-V graph ke curve ke neeche wale area se bhi nikala ja sakta hai, jaisa Fig. 6.5 mein hai.

blocks.alt: P-V graph, origin 0. Khari axis par P se dashed lakeer B tak. B se C tak teer wali magenta lakeer mustaqil dabao par, Constant pressure likha hai. V axis tak mustateel ABCD, A par V1 aur D par V2 ke darmiyan, rang bhara hai, us ke aar paar dashed do-teer delta V.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.5: Mustaqil dabao par kaam, P-V graph ke neeche ka raqba (kitab ki Figure 6.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Rectangle ABCD ki oonchai P aur chaurai V₂ − V₁ = ΔV hai, to us ka area P × ΔV hai, jo gas ka kiya hua work W hai. B se C ka teer batata hai ke gas phail rahi hai.

Internal energy ki tabdeeli aur mechanical work samajh kar ab hum woh aam usool bayan kar sakte hain jo heat energy aur us ke mechanical energy mein badalne se mutalliq hain. Inhein thermodynamics ke laws kehte hain.

rows: gas phail kar piston bahar dhakelti hai
piston andar dhakela jaye, gas dab jaye

blocks.prompt: Dikhayein ke P-V graph ke neeche ka area work ke barabar hai. Gas work kab karti hai aur gas par work kab hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Constant pressure par P-V graph V₁ se V₂ tak ek seedhi (horizontal) line hai; us ke neeche rectangle ki oonchai P aur chaurai ΔV hai, to area = PΔV = W. Pressure badalta ho to graph ko patli pattiyon mein kaat lein; har patti ka area PΔV hai, aur sab ka jor kul work hai. Gas work karti hai (positive) jab phail kar piston bahar dhakele; gas par work hota hai (negative) jab bahar ki force piston andar dhakel kar gas ko dabaye.

items: Heat aur work dono energy pohanchate hain; heat andar aur work bahar positive, system par kiya gaya work negative.
Cylinder mein gas aahista phaile to W = FΔy = PAΔy = PΔV (6.4); P-V graph ke neeche ka area work hai.
